definition: means a period of twelve months beginning from the Commencement Date and ending on the last day of such twelve-month period. For the purpose of subsequent years, Policy Year shall mean a period of twelve months commencing from the end of the previous Policy Year and lapsing on the last day of such twelve-month period.
plain: The twelve months running from your commencement date — not the calendar year, and not the financial year.
whyItMatters: Every annual limit resets on this clock: your sum insured, your restoration, your health check-up entitlement. Two hospitalisations eleven months apart can fall in the same policy year and share one limit, while two a month apart can straddle the boundary and get a fresh one each. Knowing your commencement date is worth more than it sounds.
